open_points.subject: AuditEntry sequence allocation
open_points.text: greater than every number minted before it, starting at 1; never reused, also after old entries are erased (R0-66) or the store is restored (State 2 A15)
open_points.question: What durable instance fact tells Registry the greatest sequence number ever minted, including numbers absent from the restored store and numbers allocated for changes that did not commit?
options: A separate per-instance sequence high-water fact survives rollback and restore
Every backup carries a high-water value covering all numbers minted before restoration
Restoring a store resets knowledge of discarded numbers, weakening the stated never-reuse rule
open_points.default_guess: Keep a durable per-instance sequence high-water fact that advances when a number is minted and is never rolled back by a failed change, erasure or store restoration.

open_points.subject: MigrationClosure lifecycle across restore
open_points.text: None; absent, then present forever: once a backup holding it has passed its check, no backup without it is kept (State 2 A16, A18).
open_points.question: After a successful import but before a backup containing the MigrationClosure has passed its check, may restoring an older backup make the closure absent and permit the one-time import again, or must the closure remain present throughout that interval?
options: The closure can never be lost after import succeeds, including before the first checked post-import backup
A pre-import backup may be restored during that interval, but Registry must recover or recreate the closure separately
A pre-import backup may remove the closure and reopen the import until a checked backup containing it exists
open_points.default_guess: The closure remains effective immediately and forever after the successful import; restoring a state without it must not reopen the import.
